title: docs: taught action:* nodes move their executor keys into the spec `properties` bag (objectui#11183)
body:
Fixes #11183
Clause-②: no

Every taught `action:*` node under `AGENTS.md`, `skills/objectui/**` and `content/docs/guide/**` now writes the block's props in the spec's `properties` bag, as the `@objectstack/spec` `ComponentPropsMap` row declares them, instead of flat on the node. Triage's ruling on the objectui#10872 fork, carried by the card: **A, the `properties` bag is the contract.** The spec's `PageComponentSchema` is `.strict()` (ADR-0089 D3a) and refuses a node-level `actionType` / `target` as mis-layered; objectui's `StrictAnyComponentSchema` refuses the same two keys. The runtime reads both spellings through the `SchemaRenderer` `properties` hoist, so only documents and their pins change — ⛔ no runtime or validator code in this diff.

**Order: this PR lands BEFORE PR objectui#11069** (objectui#5250, `objectui validate` onto the strict face). objectui#5250 carries `Blocked-by: #11183`; PR objectui#11069 touches `content/docs/guide/layout.md` and `schema-rendering.md` in other sections than the ones edited here (its `layout.md` hunk is the `label` / `text` paragraph under the page-buttons passage; its `schema-rendering.md` hunk is the three validation doors), so it merges `main` after this lands with no textual overlap.

Governed surface: `AGENTS.md`, `skills/objectui/SKILL.md`, `skills/objectui/guides/page-builder.md`, `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` (`node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` answers exit 3, GOVERNED). This PR stays **draft** until an APPROVED review by `os-zhuang` or `hotlong`; the claiming seat lands it. Cross-lane surface (`content/docs/**`, `packages/**` pins), declared on the claim comment of the card.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么。** 文档与测试,零运行时代码。我们教给作者(和 AI)的 `action:button` 示例,把 `actionType` / `target` 这类执行器键从节点顶层挪进了 `properties` 包里 —— 共 11 个节点、10 个文件(受管面 4 个:`AGENTS.md` 第 #4 条、`skills/objectui/SKILL.md`、`guides/page-builder.md`、`rules/protocol.md`;非受管 6 个:`content/docs/guide/` 下 4 篇指南、`content/docs/plugins/plugin-detail.mdx`、随同的两条 pin 测试)。同一家族的两处 rider 一并处理:plugin-detail 指南里的 `record:activity` 示例(`limit` / `showCompleted` 进包),以及 page-builder 技能里的 `object-form` 表单示例(objectui#11291 落地后 `objectui validate` 已按名拒绝扁平写法)。另附一个空 frontmatter 的 changeset(声明不发版)。

**为什么改。** spec 的 `PageComponentSchema` 是 `.strict()` 的(ADR-0089 D3a),节点顶层出现 `actionType` / `target` 会被当作错层键直接拒绝;objectui 自己的严格校验面 `StrictAnyComponentSchema` 同样拒绝这两个键。PR objectui#11069 正要把 `objectui validate` 切到这个严格面,届时受管规程文件里的标准示例就会变成校验器拒收的节点,而 agent 会照抄示例。裁决是「教的内容向 spec 靠」,不是反过来给 objectui 开一条 spec 拒绝的扁平通道。实测:12 个被改示例在改前全部被两个严格面拒绝,改后在宽容面、严格面、spec 三面全部通过(见下方 census)。

**风险与代价(含回滚)。** 运行时无变化:`SchemaRenderer` 把 `properties` 整包提升到节点上再交给渲染器,两种拼写渲染结果相同;`guide-layout-page-buttons-7926` 这条真实渲染 pin 读的就是 layout 指南里被改的那段 JSON,改后 Edit / Delete 两个按钮照常画出。代价是示例各长了 2–5 行。回滚:revert 本 PR 即可,没有任何生成物、锁文件或发布物需要同步;但回滚后 objectui#11069 不能先落地,否则规程示例会被校验器拒收。

**席位意见。**(留空)

**你要做的。** 作为受管面 PR,需要你(`os-zhuang` / `hotlong`)在本 PR 上留一条 APPROVED review;之后由认领席翻 ready 并入合并队列,⛔ 本 PR 不自行 ready、不自行入队。请顺手确认 `AGENTS.md` #4 的新措辞(「props 住在 `properties` 包里,⛔ 不写在节点顶层」)是你希望 agent 读到的规则。

## Census (the gate the card asks for)

Instrument: for every `"type": "action:button|icon|group|menu"` node under `content/docs/**`, `skills/**`, `AGENTS.md`, `README.md` (`grep -rnE '"type":\s*"action:(button|icon|group|menu)"' content/docs skills AGENTS.md README.md`), the keys written at the node's own level — `actionType`, `target`, `endpoint`, `method`, `name`, `icon`, `variant`, `params`, `label` — before the next node or the closing brace.

| reading | action nodes | nodes with a flat row key |
|---|---:|---:|
| base `caa0cd392` (objectui `origin/main` at cut) | 11 | 11 |
| this branch `f580661` | 11 | 0 |

Per site (base → branch), by heading, all in one commit each:

| file | site | moved into `properties` |
|---|---|---|
| `AGENTS.md` | #4 example (one-line node) | `label`, `actionType`, `target` |
| `skills/objectui/SKILL.md` | "4. The action system" | `label`, `actionType`, `target` |
| `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` | "Rule: Actions Are Node Types, Not An Event Bag" (the node example only; the 「Readers only.」 paragraph is #11009's and is untouched) | `label`, `actionType`, `target` |
| `skills/objectui/guides/page-builder.md` | "5. Use action data" | `label`, `actionType`, `target` |
| `skills/objectui/guides/page-builder.md` | "Form plugin example" (`object-form` rider) | `objectName`, `mode`, `fields` |
| `content/docs/guide/quick-start.md` | "Add Actions" | `label`, `actionType`, `target` |
| `content/docs/guide/record-edit-modes.md` | "Triggering the routes from JSON", three nodes | `label`, `icon`, `actionType`, and the already-bagged `params` stays in the same bag |
| `content/docs/guide/schema-rendering.md` | "Reference actions in schemas" | `name`, `label`, `actionType`, `endpoint`, `method` |
| `content/docs/guide/layout.md` | "Detail Page with Actions", two nodes | `name`, `label`, `variant`, `icon`, `actionType` |
| `content/docs/plugins/plugin-detail.mdx` | "The `record:activity` block" (`record:activity` rider) | `limit`, `showCompleted` |

Each edited fence judged on three faces (a probe run from `packages/types` against the source `zod/index.zod.ts` and the installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.5.0): at base, every one of the 12 is refused by `StrictAnyComponentSchema` and by the spec's `PageComponentSchema` with exactly the flat keys named above (the `object-form` one is refused on the tolerant face too, by name, since objectui#11291); on this branch all 12 pass tolerant, strict and spec. The prose beside each fence moved with it: the sentence "the node's own keys carry that executor's arguments" now reads "the row's other keys" / "the bag's other keys", and each site says why the flat spelling is refused.

`skills/**` line readings (the governed-surface reading, lines; no token meter exists for this surface — `check:skill-eval-tokens` meters eval `must_contain` tokens, not file length): `SKILL.md` 137 → 142, `guides/page-builder.md` 346 → 353, `rules/protocol.md` 364 → 370; bundle `skills/objectui/**/*.md` 4782 → 4800; all `SKILL.md` files 137 → 142. The whole increase is the bag's two wrapper lines per fence plus the one-sentence refusal note; nothing was re-wrapped.

## Pins moved

- `packages/types/src/__tests__/held-public-block-arms-10872.test.ts` (reads the quick-start's "Add Actions" fence): the taught node now validates AS WRITTEN on both faces and on the spec's `PageComponentSchema`; the pre-move flat spelling is DERIVED from the taught node (bag hoisted flat) and pinned as refused by exactly `actionType` and `target` on both strict faces while the tolerant face still keeps it — so the reading of the refusal stays live and moves with the page.
- `packages/cli/src/__tests__/registered-types-validate-ratchet-10859.test.ts` (same fence, through `objectui validate`): lit control that the extracted node is in the bag spelling; the row still passes the tolerant face `validate` runs today and will pass the strict one PR objectui#11069 wires. ⛔ Its header and `refusedAtType` helper — the lines PR objectui#11069 edits — are untouched here.
- Reverse leg, run with the pins committed: `git checkout BASE -- content/docs/guide/quick-start.md` ⇒ 4 red (`reads the taught node … bag spelling`, `strict face: the taught node AS WRITTEN … validates`, `the spec's own PageComponentSchema accepts the taught node as written`, the ratchet's `validates a page with the taught action:button node`), 60 green; `git checkout HEAD -- …` restored, `git diff HEAD` empty, `git hash-object` of the page equals its HEAD blob `ca70f902fc5c…`.

## Acceptance notes

- **`packages/plugin-detail/README.md` — the `items` half of the `record:activity` rider is NOT moved, by measurement.** `ComponentPropsMap['record:activity']` on the installed spec has no `items` key (its keys: `aria`, `enableMentions`, `enableReactions`, `enableThreading`, `filterMode`, `limit`, `showCommentInput`, `showCompleted`, `showFilterToggle`, `showSubscriptionToggle`, `types`, `unifiedTimeline`), and both objectui faces refuse `properties.items` by name, so the bag spelling would turn a working example into a refused one. The README's example is TSX code composing a `DetailViewSchema` whose Activity tab hands the block a host-supplied feed — `record-activity.tsx` reads `schema.items` as the first of its three feed sources — the same runtime-slot shape as `record:history`'s `entries`. Left as is; reported in the dev report for the `domain:ui` lane to rule on whether `items` wants a named RUNTIME SLOT refusal on the authoring faces.
- **Out of the roots, same family: `packages/app-shell/README.md`** teaches two flat `action:button` nodes (`navigate_create` / `navigate_edit`, under "The handler name goes in `actionType`"), the twin of the `record-edit-modes.md` passage moved here. Outside the claimed surface; in the dev report as a finding, not edited.
- **Different family, noted: `content/docs/api/schema-reference.md` "ActionSchema"** teaches `"type": "action"` nodes with `actionType: "ajax"` and an `api` key — a vocabulary `schema-rendering.md` itself says no action renderer forwards. Not an `action:*` public block; not edited.
- Zone 2 item 4 of the dispatch assumed `check:skill-eval-tokens` meters skill-file length; it meters eval `must_contain` tokens against the bundle (its header's "THE ORACLE" section). No length ceiling gate exists for `skills/**` in this tree; the line readings above are reported in its place.
- objectui#11198 (`guides/app-composition.md` nav label) does not ride this PR; that file is untouched.
